CHAT_WEBHOOK_URL.title: Private Google Chat webhook
CHAT_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Used for OTP requests and failure alerts. Use a NEW private Chat space/webhook, not the shared GCX team room webhook.

GWS_TOKEN_JSON.title: Google OAuth token JSON
GWS_TOKEN_JSON.description: Full contents of ~/.config/gws_shim/token.json, used for the Google Sheets upload.

HEADLESS.title: Run headless (always enforced)
HEADLESS.description: Apify containers have no display, so headless is always forced on regardless of this value. Use the per-step checkpoint screenshots saved to the Key-Value Store to inspect what happened during a run.

DIAGNOSE_ACCOUNTS.title: Diagnostic mode: capture account-picker HTML only
DIAGNOSE_ACCOUNTS.description: When ON, dumps full page HTML (and any account-switcher dropdown, clicked open) for each domain's landing page to the Key-Value Store, then exits immediately — no scraping, no Sheets upload. Used to inspect Amazon's account-selection UI structure.

ISOLATED_TEST_DOMAIN.title: Diagnostic mode: isolated fresh-login test for one domain
ISOLATED_TEST_DOMAIN.description: Set to US/EU/JP/IN to force a completely fresh, throwaway Chrome profile and test whether that domain's own credentials reach a genuinely different account than the shared profile shows. Leave empty for normal runs.
